liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Brown Eyed Women** (1 review): Review notes Jerry saved up for a fierce solo in Brown Eyed Women [15]
- **It Must Have Been The Roses** (1 review): Reviewer loves the second set, citing Roses as their personal favorite version [16]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Review highlights a great second set jam and a nice mini melt into drums [10]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-01-10.mtx.Rhinotrocity7.motb.95134.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 189 min; rated 4.78/5 by 9 [1]. Said about its sound: Matrix recording is described as crisp, clean, and solid, with sound rated five; Franklin's Tower is tasty, though Jerry's voice remained hagged at the end of set two; Jerry's recovering laryngitis adds trippiness and uniqueness to his moving vocal performance [1][11][15][16]
- **gd1978-01-10.133619.sbd.miller.flac24**: soundboard; 22 songs; 173 min [2]
- **gd1978-01-10.aud.Rhinotrocity7.motb-0026.95068.flac16**: audience recording; 22 songs; 166 min; rated 4.43/5 by 7 [4]. Said about its sound: Review calls the recording sweet-sounding, competing with Nashville Auditorium for best 1978 audience tape [6]
- **gd1978-01-10.133618.sbd.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 173 min [3]

## Around the show

- Band overcame early technical problems to sustain energy throughout the performance [11]
- Crowd enjoyed Donna's tasty performance of Sunrise, despite the reviewer's usual dislike of her [12]
- Jerry grinned and sang Bertha's opening, exploding crowd joy after previous laryngitis shows [13]
- Jerry's vocals show lingering laryngitis effects, but he compensates with determined playing [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-01-10.mtx.Rhinotrocity7.motb.95134.flac16**: taped by Reinhart Hohlwein; transferred by Bob Menke and Derek McCabe and Adam Egert; source: Matrix (See Notes) [1]. Also: Audience source is Maxell UDXL II cassettes from AKG D224Es and Sony TC 158; Transfer path includes Nakamichi CR7a, Korg MR-1000, and Korg AudioGate to 24/96 WAV [1]
- **gd1978-01-10.133619.sbd.miller.flac24**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Dolby B) -> FLAC (24bit/44.1k) [2]. Also: Thanks Matt Smith for his endless contributions to the SBD recording [2]
- **gd1978-01-10.aud.Rhinotrocity7.motb-0026.95068.flac16**: taped by Reinhart Hohlwein; transferred by Bob Menke and Derek McCabe and Adam Egert; source: 2 x AKG D224E's => Sony TC 158 >> MAC (3 x Maxell UDXL II) [4]. Also: First set tape stopped between songs; no patches applied to this audience version; Matrix version includes crowd patches between songs and a drum solo patch [4]
- **gd1978-01-10.133618.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Dolby B) -> FLAC (24bit/44.1k) [3]
